_tuning_notes: Black bear: forests, smaller (size_scale), and special.timid makes it FLEE players — unless cubs are nearby, when mother-aggro overrides everything. Same class as the taiga grizzly. Phase 3: salmon (diet) baits cage traps; needs the reinforced tier. RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-3, cap 3). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions.
guide_blurb: Shy, unless you find the cubs first.
